decisions.proposed_text: Về nhì 3 lần trong các cuộc đua cấp G1
decisions.reason: Current text uses forbidden GⅠ formatting; second-place count and race context are preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng Centaur Stakes (Classic Class) với cách biệt từ 4 thân ngựa trở lên, đồng thời thắng Sprinters Stakes và Takamatsunomiya Kinen, và đánh bại Durandal cùng Calstone Light O ít nhất 2 lần mỗi đối thủ
decisions.reason: Current text misidentifies Calstone Light O as Kinshasa no Kiseki and uses noncanonical Cấp Classic; revision restores both locked identities while preserving all race and numeric conditions.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded character.durandal requires Durandal, character.calstone_light_o requires Calstone Light O, and race.class.classic.race_text requires Classic Class.

decisions.reason: Race objective and all three opponent names are accurate, including the requirement to beat each at least twice.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded locks for Agnes Tachyon, Jungle Pocket, and Manhattan Cafe are all satisfied.

decisions.proposed_text:
Kích hoạt Hot Spring Power 20 lần
※Chỉ áp dụng trong Gokuraku♪ Yukoma Onsenkyo
decisions.reason: Current text uses the forbidden Sức mạnh rendering for the Power component; revision preserves the named hot-spring mechanic, count, newline, and scenario restriction.

decisions.reason: Accurately requires performing the PR activity 3 times and preserves the scenario restriction and newline.
Accurately requires finishing every bathing session at the specified Good Hot Spring-or-better rating and preserves the scenario restriction.
Accurately requires completing excavation of the legendary secret hot spring and preserves the scenario restriction.
Accurately requires raising any excavation-power stat to [A2] or above and completing training; threshold and scenario restriction are preserved.
Accurately requires activating Super Recovery 15 times and preserves the scenario restriction.
All six race wins, the first-favorite condition for every race, and completion of training are preserved accurately.

decisions.proposed_text: Hoàn tất huấn luyện với mọi cuộc đua đều nằm trong top 3, đi chơi cùng Mã Nương huấn luyện ít nhất 2 lần và Số fan đạt từ 500000 trở lên
decisions.reason: Current text uses forbidden generic Uma Musume terminology and omits the locked Số fan label; all thresholds and conditions are preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương and progress.fans requires Số fan.

decisions.reason: Current text uses forbidden Kỹ năng for the generic gameplay category; numeric threshold is preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.skill.generic requires Skill and forbids Kỹ năng.

decisions.proposed_text: Dùng chiến thuật “Bám giữa” để thắng Kikuka Sho trong thời tiết [Mưa], đồng thời dùng chiến thuật “Dẫn đầu” để thắng Japan Cup (Senior Class)
decisions.reason: Current text uses noncanonical Cấp Senior for the locked race class; tactics, weather condition, and race objectives are preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng Aoba Sho và Tokyo Yushun, đồng thời Số fan đạt từ 480000 trở lên
decisions.reason: Current text expresses the count but omits the locked player-facing Số fan label; race wins and threshold are preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, Shuka Sho và Japan Cup, đồng thời hoàn tất huấn luyện khi duy trì Mood “Tuyệt hảo” trong tất cả các cuộc đua
decisions.reason: Current text translates the player-facing Mood state as tinh thần; revision restores canonical Mood while preserving all race and condition semantics.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.state.mood and source-bridge state.mood require Mood and forbid Tinh thần/Hứng khởi.
